transcript.text: Good evening, everyone. Let's get started on the pre-air lock meeting for the talent-show finale. We've got the live broadcast this Saturday at 9:00 PM Eastern, and we need to finalize the voting package tonight so standards, platform production, rights, and data protection can all sign off before transmission. The current draft has SMS and online portal voting open to our broadcast audience. Before I make the final call on the voting package, I want to hear from each of you — what issues or concerns do we need to address?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a standards issue before we finalize. The network's current standards memo — which was issued after the draft voting rules were circulated — specifies three requirements that the current draft doesn't yet reflect: voters must be at least 13 years old, each voter may cast exactly one vote per verified account, and voting must close at 9:50 PM Eastern. These are binding standards requirements that need to be incorporated into the final voting package.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical platform production issue. I completed the platform certification test this morning, and the SMS integration failed certification — it is not approved for use. The web portal did pass certification, but the approved portal requires account verification before a vote is accepted. This means SMS voting cannot go forward on Saturday as currently drafted, and the final voting package needs to reflect web-portal-only voting with the account verification requirement.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a rights issue with the voting interface. I obtained the finalist label's written approval today, and it confirms that the voting interface may display finalist names and approved headshots, but it may NOT use any finalist performance audio or video. The current draft interface still contains performance clips, so those need to be removed before we finalize the package.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag a data protection issue. My privacy review with the voting vendor, completed this week, established two binding requirements that the current draft does not reflect: first, participation must be limited to viewers physically located in the United States and Canada — the draft still describes worldwide participation. Second, voter identifiers must be deleted within 30 days — the current draft has no deletion step at all. Both of these need to be incorporated into the final voting package before I can sign off.
transcript.speaker: A5
